hero.board.title: Bhodhi rekuvhura
services.description: Tinobatanidza urongwa hwezvemukati, dhizaini yeinterface nekuita basa rehunyanzvi, kuti website yako isangoramba iri pamhepo asi ishande chaizvo.
services.0.title: Portfolio / CV yako
services.0.description: Website yeportfolio kana CV yako yekuratidza mbiri yako, ruzivo rwako nemabasa ako nenzira yehunyanzvi.
services.1.title: Landing page kana mbiri yekambani
services.1.description: Landing page kana mbiri yekambani inokurumidza kuvhurwa, inovimbisa, uye yakagadzirira kukwezva vatengi.
services.2.title: Sisitimu yeruzivo nemabasa
services.2.description: Madashboard, mapotari nemasisitimu emukati ekubata data yako nemabasa ebhizinesi enguva dzose.
services.3.title: Automation
services.3.description: Shandisa automation pamabasa anodzokororwa senge zviziviso, kubatanidza maturusi nemaitiro ebasa kuti chikwata chako chiponese nguva.
process.description: Chikamu chimwe nechimwe chine zvinobuda zvaunogona kuona, kuyedza nekubvumira. Unoziva chaizvo kuti basa riri kuenda kupi.
process.0.title: Kuongorora zvinodiwa
process.0.description: Tinoronga zvinangwa zvebhizinesi, mienzaniso yaunoda, mabasa akakosha nezvinokosha pakutanga.
process.1.title: Kuongorora dhizaini
process.1.description: Chimiro, dhizaini nenzira yepeji zvinoongororwa nekubvumirwa pamwe chete tisati tatanga kugadzira.
process.2.title: Kuvaka
process.2.description: Website, app kana automation inovakwa ichienderana nescreen dzakasiyana maererano nedhizaini yakabvumirwa.
process.3.title: Kuongorora mhedzisiro
process.3.description: Mhedzisiro inoongororwa pamwe chete, inogadziridzwa kana zvichidiwa, ichiyedzwa kusvikira yagadzirira kuvhurwa.
process.4.title: Kuvhura nekuendesa
process.4.description: Chigadzirwa chinoburitswa, metadata neSEO zvinogadzirwa, ipapo tinokupa kodzero dzekupinda nenhungamiro.
services.0.long: Website yeportfolio kana CV yako imba yako yepamutemo paInternet. Mbiri yako, ruzivo rwako nemabasa ako zvinoungana zvakanaka papeji imwe, zviri nyore kutumira kuvanopa mabasa, vatengi kana mayunivhesiti.
services.0.for: Vakangopedza kudzidza, mafreelancer, vagadziri vezvemukati nevanyanzvi vanoda kuoneka vachivimbisa.
services.1.long: Landing page kana mbiri yekambani inobatsira bhizinesi kuita mutsa pakuona kwekutanga. Tinogadzira kuyerera kwepeji, mashoko nechitarisiko kuti vashanyi vanzwisise nekukurumidza zvaunopa uye vafare kutaura newe.
services.1.for: Mabhizinesi, zvikoro, makafe, nharaunda nemakambani anoda chitarisiko chehunyanzvi.
services.2.long: Sisitimu yeruzivo inoronga basa rave kuparadzirwa muma spreadsheet, manotsi nemachati. Data iri panzvimbo imwe, inowanikwa maererano nebasa romushandisi, uye mareport anogona kuonekwa chero nguva.
services.2.detail.0: Maitiro ebasa akarongeka anoteedzera maitiro ako
services.2.for: Zvikoro, masangano, mashopu, mapurazi nemakambani anoda kubata data yawo nenzira inorongeka.
services.3.long: Mabasa anodzokororwa senge kutumira zviziviso, kutamisa data pakati pema app, kana kugadzira mareport enguva dzose anogona kuzviitira oga. Chikwata chako chinoponesa nguva uye chinorega kukanganisa pakunyora.
services.3.detail.2: Maitiro ekubvumira nekuita mareport anozviita oga
services.3.for: Mabhizinesi nezvikwata zvine mabasa mazhinji anodzokororwa nemaoko.
process.0.long: Tisati tavaka chinhu, tinoda kunzwisisa bhizinesi rako: chinangwa chacho, vashanyi vacho, uye mabasa akakosha. Kubva ipapo tinoronga zvinokosha kuti basa riwane chinangwa uye mari isapambadzwe.
process.0.you: Tiudze zvaunoda uye ugovane mienzaniso yemawebsite aunofarira.
process.0.result: Rondedzero yezvinodiwa nezvinokosha zvakabvumiranwa pamwe chete.
process.1.long: Tinotanga tarongera chimiro chemapeji nemufananidzo wechitarisiko. Unogona kuzviongorora uye kutipa maonero ako tisati tatanga kuvaka, kuti mhedzisiro ive pedyo nezvawakafungidzira.
process.1.you: Ongorora dhizaini, ipapo utipe maonero kana kubvuma.
process.1.result: Dhizaini yakabvumiranwa pamwe chete basa risati ratanga.
process.2.long: Dhizaini yacho kana yabvumirwa, website, app kana automation inovakwa. Inoenderana nescreen dzefoni nedzekombiyuta, uye unogona kugovera maonero ako basa richiri kuenda.
process.2.do.1: Kuona kuti zvinooneka zvakanaka pafoni, patablet napakombiyuta
process.2.do.3: Kugovera mashoko ekufambira mberi nguva nenguva
process.2.you: Gadzirira zvinyorwa, mifananidzo nemalogo, ugovane maonero kana uine.
process.2.result: Vhezheni yekutanga yaunogona kuyedza. Website nyore inowanzopedzwa mukati memazuva 1–3 ebasa zvinhu zvagadzirira.
process.3.long: Tinoyedza mhedzisiro pamwe chete. Chisina kukwana chinogadziridzwa, ipapo zvose zvinoyedzwazve kusvikira zvashanda zvakanaka pamidziyo yakasiyana uye zvagadzirira kuvhurwa.
process.3.you: Yedza mhedzisiro uye utiudze zvaungade kugadziriswa.
process.4.long: Chigadzirwa chinoburitswa uye chinovhurirwa munhu wose. Tinochigadzirira kuti chiwanikwe paGoogle, ipapo tinokupa kodzero dzekupinda pamwe nenhungamiro yekushandisa kuti ugone kuchibata zvakanaka.
process.4.do.3: Kukutsigira negore rimwe rekuchengetedza kwemahara, pamwe nedomain (Pakeji Diki) kana hosting (Pakeji Guru)
process.4.you: Chengetedza kodzero dzako dzekupinda zvakanaka uye utange kugovera vatengi vako.
process.4.result: Website kana app iri pamhepo uye yagadzirira kushandiswa.
projects.description: Purojekiti imwe neimwe yakagadzirwa kuti iparidze mashoko ebhizinesi zvakajeka, ienderane nechero chishandiso, uye ireruse kuti vashandisi vaite chiito.
packages.description: Mitengo inogona kugadziriswa mushure mekurukurirana kuti bhajeti, nguva nemhedzisiro zvive zvechokwadi.

packages.1.name: Guru

faq.title: Mibvunzo inowanzoitika tisati tatanga.
faq.description: Kana mubvunzo wako usina kupindurwa pano, kurukurirana kunogona kubatsira kuziva zvaunoda.
faq.0.question: Nocoding inogona kugadzira masevhisi api?
faq.0.answer: Tinogadzira mawebsite eportfolio kana CV yako, landing page kana mbiri yekambani, masisitimu eruzivo nemabasa, uye automation yemaitiro ebhizinesi.
faq.1.question: Basa rekuvaka rinotora nguva yakareba sei?
faq.1.answer: Portfolio, CV kana landing page nyore inowanzotora mazuva 1-3 ebasa zvinhu zvagadzirira. Mapurojekiti makuru anoenderana nemabasa anodiwa, kubatanidza uye nekukurumidza kwemaonero.
faq.2.question: Dhizaini nemabasa zvinogona kugadziriswa here?
faq.2.answer: Hongu. Dhizaini, chimiro chemapeji, mabasa nemaitiro ebasa zvinogadziriswa maererano nezvaunoda. Dhizaini inoongororwa pamwe chete tisati tatanga kuvaka.
faq.3.question: Mutengo unosanganisira chii?
faq.3.answer: Mutengo unosanganisira kuvaka maererano nepakeji nechiyero zvakabvumiranwa. Pakeji Diki inosanganisira kuchengetedza kwemahara nedomain kwegore 1, nepo Pakeji Guru ichisanganisira kuchengetedza kwemahara nehosting kwegore 1.
contact.title: Tiudze zvinodiwa newebsite yako. Tichakubatsira kururamisa nzira.
contact.description: Tumira pfupiso pfupi yebhizinesi rako, mapeji aunoda nenguva yaunoda. Mhinduro yekutanga ichasanganisira zvatinokurudzira pachiyero uye matanho anotevera. Kurukurirana kuri mahara nguva dzose, chero painodiwa.
footer.tagline: Mawebsite ebhizinesi akagadzirira kuvhurwa, anooneka akakomba, uye ari nyore kukudza.
project.description.ecoswap: Musika wepamhepo wekutenga nekutengesa zvinhu zvakashandiswa. Vanhu vanogona kuisa, kutsvaga nekutenga zviri nyore pafoni kana pakombiyuta.
project.description.wiboost: Chitoro chepamhepo chemasevhisi edhijitari senge kuisa mari mumitambo, mapakeji edata nema app epremium, ine mari yevatengi nechirongwa chevanotengesazve.
project.description.ahawi: Website yeportfolio yomunhu ine maitiro ewatercolor nemitauro miviri, yekuratidza mbiri, ruzivo nenzira dzekubata.
project.description.abdi: Sisitimu yemarekodhi evashandi vomuumbowo (abdi dalem) veKeraton yeSurakarta: kunyoresa, data yomunhu, ndandanda yezviitiko, kupinda nekudhinda makadhi ekuzivikanwa.
project.description.sfarm: App yekubata purazi renharaunda rehuku dzinoisa mazai nembudzi: marekodhi emazuva ose, kutengesa, mari inoshandiswa nemareport emari.
project.description.payu: Platform inobatanidza vanoisa mabasa nemafreelancer. Anoisa basa anopa mubayiro, freelancer anopedza basa, uye kubhadhara kunoitwa neQRIS.
project.description.darcasual: Katalogi yepamhepo ine zvigadzirwa zvinopfuura chiuru. Vatengi vanogona kutsvaga, kusefa nekuodha zvakananga neWhatsApp.
project.description.ianprem: Chitoro chepamhepo cheaccount dzema app epremium senge Netflix neSpotify. Vatengi vanosarudza nekubhadhara voga, nepo maadmin vachibata stock nekutengesa.
project.description.alengka: Katalogi yepamhepo yemidziyo yomukati nepanze yemakafe, maresitorendi nedzimba. Vashanyi vanogona kuona zvinhu zvose nekubvunza neWhatsApp.
project.description.sdn: Website yepamutemo yechikoro chepuraimari ine mbiri yechikoro, ruzivo rwekutorwa kwevadzidzi vitsva, rondedzero yevadzidzisi, zviitiko zvekunze kwemakirasi nezvakawanikwa nevadzidzi.
project.description.furnix: Katalogi yepamhepo yemidziyo yesimbi inobva kuJepara yemakafe, maresitorendi nedzimba. Vashanyi vanogona kusarudza zvigadzirwa nekuodha maererano nezvavanoda.
project.description.clothique: Chitoro chepamhepo chenguo chakakwana: katalogi, ngoro yekutenga, kubhadhara pamhepo, blog, nenzvimbo yeadmin yekubata maodha nemareport.
project.description.agli: Chishandiso chezvikwata zvezvemukati chinounganidza mienzaniso yezvemukati inotariswa zvikuru, chinoona mapatani, uye chinonyora zvinyorwa zvitsva zvekutanga.
project.description.nebulist: Mubatsiri wekutengesa une AI anogadzira nzira, manotsi evangave vatengi nezvinyorwa zvemashoko ekutora vatengi achibva paruzivo rwechigadzirwa.
project.description.carbonfi: App yemari yedhijitari yekutengeserana makiredhiti ecarbon (mibayiro yekudzikisa utsi) nezvirongwa zvemibayiro inochengetedza zvakatipoteredza.
project.description.protectedpay: App yakachengeteka yekutumira mari yedhijitari: mari inosunungurwa chete kana yagamuchirwa, ine kubhadhara kwemapoka nekuchengetedza.
project.description.pedulichain: Platform yezvipo ine pachena: chipo chimwe nechimwe nekushandiswa kwemari zvinorekodhwa nokusingaperi uye zvinoonekwa nomunhu wose.
project.description.astra: Mubatsiri we AI waunongotaura naye kuti ubate zvinhu zvedhijitari, senge kutumira matokeni kana kugadzira zvinhu zvedhijitari zvekuunganidza, pasina kuziva coding.
project.description.auditfi: Chishandiso chekuongorora kuchengeteka chinoshandisa AI chezvirongwa zvemari yedhijitari chinowana nzvimbo dzakaneta uye chinonyora report mumasekonzi.
project.description.p2p: Platform yekuchinjana zvinhu zvedhijitari zvakananga pakati pevashandisi, ine dziviriro yemitengeserano nenzvimbo yeadmin yekumhanyisa platform.
project.description.payguppy: App inobatsira zvitoro zvakajairika kugamuchira kubhadhara nemari yedhijitari vachishandisa makodhi eQR avanayo kare.
project.description.tiptap: Platform yevagadziri vezvemukati kugamuchira tipu kubva kuvaoni mumari yedhijitari kana zvinhu zvedhijitari zvekuunganidza, ine zviziviso panguva dzekutepfenyura mhenyu.
project.description.senkus: Mutambo wepamhepo une musoro wesayenzi nealchemy: vatambi vanosanganisa mishonga, vanounganidza zvinhu zvedhijitari uye vanokwikwidzana muarena.
project.description.quickstock: App yekombiyuta yekubata stock yechitoro chenguo: kurekodha kutengesa, kuunzwa nevanopa, nemareport estock, ine kupinda maererano nebasa romushandi mumwe nomumwe.
project.description.caer: Platform yekukweretesa nekukwereta zvinhu zvedhijitari pamanetiweki akasiyana inotsigira rupiah yedhijitari IDRX, zvichiita kuti kuchengeta nekukwereta zvive nyore.
